additional.title: Solemn announcement after the Gospel
additional.text: Note: The solemn announcement may be proclaimed after the Gospel reading. Know ye, beloved brethren, that as by God's favor we rejoiced in the Nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ, so too we announce to you the glad tidings of the Resurrection of the same our Savior. The Sunday of Septuagesima will fall on the 8th day of February; Ash Wednesday and the beginning of the most Holy Lenten fast on the 25th day of February. On the 12th day of April, you shall celebrate with greatest joy the Holy Pasch of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ will occur on the 21st day of May; the Feast of Pentecost on the 31st day of May; and the Feast of Corpus Christi on the 11th day of June. The 29th day of November will usher in the Advent of our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom be glory and honor, for ever and ever.
